journal_lines: §oSmelled iron and old wood smoke before the clearing opened. Camp had been empty a long time.
§aLogging camp abandoned with the tools still laid out. §lWoodcutter§a took the timber. Miner took the iron fittings.
Stumps the size of cartwheels all around the clearing. Whoever had worked here had really worked.
§aTools still hung on the rack. Axe heads, wedges, iron spikes. §lCamp§a gave up everything useful.
A coat on a peg, weather-rotted down to nothing. Bowl on the table, full of pine needles. Took the metal. Left the rest.
Camp tools laid out for a morning that had not arrived in years. We arrived instead.
§oThe big trees still standing around the edges had been spared for a reason. Took the felled ones. Left those.
§aWoodcutter identified the salvage. Miner identified the iron. Two roles, one abandoned camp, two full bags.
